info.title: V-Scheduler Public API
info.description: V-Scheduler controls task execution and resource reservations on managed VOS or remote nodes; it does not proxy model payloads. Cloud provider models bypass local scheduling through V-Router. Synchronous local models use V-Router permits; asynchronous application work uses tasks. MVP implementation v0.1.0. Authenticated app-scoped access; static executors and one active execution lane per node; no HA or dynamic enrollment.

x-description.zh-CN: 网关创建 HTTP、SSE、WebSocket 或异步模型工作前申请资源。executor_id 与 upstream_url 必须匹配已批准执行器及真实节点；model_id 用于审计，预算来自固定模板。节点离线、遥测过期、排空、系统余量或预约不足时拒绝，不得失败后直跑。异步任务确认不是停止证据。云端供应商不调用此接口。
x-description.en: Admit HTTP, SSE, WebSocket or asynchronous model creation before computation. executor_id and upstream_url must match an approved executor on the actual node; model_id is recorded for audit. Fixed budgets, fresh telemetry and system headroom gate admission. An async receipt is not stop evidence. Cloud providers do not call this API.
x-description.zh-TW: 網關建立 HTTP、SSE、WebSocket 或非同步模型工作前申請資源。executor_id 與 upstream_url 須匹配已核准執行器及實際節點；model_id 用於稽核，預算來自固定範本。節點離線、遙測過期、排空、系統餘量或預約不足時拒絕。非同步任務確認不是停止證據。雲端供應商不呼叫此介面。

x-description.zh-CN: 按服务 app_id 隔离的许可历史，可按状态筛选并分页。包括模型、节点、预算、父任务、释放依据与首次释放时间；旧记录缺少释放时间时返回 null。释放或移交不表示推理成功。管理员可查看全部。
x-description.en: App-scoped permit history with optional state filtering and pagination, model, node, budget, parent task, release evidence and first release time. Older undated releases remain null. Release or handoff does not imply inference succeeded. Administrators can inspect all apps.
x-description.zh-TW: 按服務 app_id 隔離的許可歷史，可按狀態篩選及分頁。包括模型、節點、預算、父任務、釋放依據與首次釋放時間；舊記錄缺少釋放時間時回傳 null。釋放或移交不代表推論成功。管理員可查看全部。

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Optional state filter, applied before pagination and within the authenticated app scope.

post.summary: Claim or verify a bound backend execution permit
post.description: Backend-scoped verification. Requires an approved permit_executors grant (or own executor), exact executor/node/upstream/model binding and a private execution token. claim=true atomically consumes the initial claim; claim=false checks the same execution. Does not reserve again, renew, transfer or release ownership.

x-description.zh-CN: 无法确认停止时 stopped=false；预约转为 suspect 并保留容量。
x-description.en: When stop is unconfirmed, stopped=false keeps capacity reserved as suspect.
x-description.zh-TW: 無法確認停止時 stopped=false；預約轉為 suspect 並保留容量。

x-description.zh-CN: 验证已批准执行器、真实节点与业务 job ID 后原子释放桥接许可，由持久任务承担预算。仅声明 delegated 不构成证明。
x-description.en: Atomically hand a bridge permit to a durable task after verifying approved executor, actual node and business job ID. A delegated declaration is not proof.
x-description.zh-TW: 驗證已核准執行器、實際節點與業務 job ID 後原子移交橋接許可至持久任務。

x-description.zh-CN: 网关核验运行任务的用户、批准执行器、节点、地址及父预约剩余预算，申请关联子许可，不重复扣节点资源。须提供幂等键；子调用未证实停止时父预约保持占用。
x-description.en: Verify running task owner, approved executor, node, endpoint and remaining parent budget before acquiring a linked permit. Requires Idempotency-Key; parent capacity remains held until every child confirms stop.
x-description.zh-TW: 網關驗證執行任務的使用者、已核准執行器、節點、位址及父預約剩餘預算，申請關聯子許可；子呼叫未確認停止時父預約持續占用。

get.description: Fixed 24-hour operational samples from core PostgreSQL; no inference outcome is inferred from permit release.

x-description.zh-CN: 固定最近 24 小时，按服务 app_id 隔离，管理员可查看全部。首次排队只取任务第一次分配；执行占用按分配至确认停止计算，包含重试执行。任务失败率不计取消；许可释放不是推理成功。缺少释放时间的旧许可不进入耗时样本。P50 无样本、P95 少于 20 个样本时返回 null。
x-description.en: Fixed last 24 hours, scoped to the authenticated app; administrators see all apps. First queue wait uses the first assignment only. Occupancy runs from assignment to confirmed stop and includes retry attempts. Cancellations do not count toward task failure rate; permit release is not inference success. Undated old permits are excluded from timing samples. P50 without samples and P95 below 20 samples are null.
x-description.zh-TW: 固定最近 24 小時，按服務 app_id 隔離，管理員可查看全部。首次排隊只取任務第一次分配；執行占用按分配至確認停止計算，包含重試執行。任務失敗率不計取消；許可釋放不是推論成功。缺少釋放時間的舊許可不納入耗時樣本。P50 無樣本、P95 少於 20 個樣本時回傳 null。

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Exclusive before-event cursor; 0 selects the latest page.

get.description: Saved state/progress snapshots for one visible task, newest first. cursor is an exclusive before-event cursor, 0 or omitted selects the newest page. next_cursor is null when there is no older page. Existing /events forward-cursor semantics are unchanged.

x-description.zh-CN: 按最新事件在前查询单个任务的已保存状态与进度快照。cursor 为排他式向前翻页的事件游标，0 或省略表示最新页；next_cursor 为 null 表示没有更早记录。原 /events 的正向游标语义不变。
x-description.en: Saved state/progress snapshots for one visible task, newest first. cursor is an exclusive before-event cursor, 0 or omitted selects the newest page. next_cursor is null when there is no older page. Existing /events forward-cursor semantics are unchanged.
x-description.zh-TW: 按最新事件在前查詢單一任務已儲存的狀態與進度快照。cursor 為查詢更早事件的排他游標，0 或省略表示最新頁；next_cursor 為 null 表示沒有更早紀錄。原 /events 的正向游標語意不變。

progress.description: Latest progress snapshot. percent, if present, is a fraction from 0 to 1; stage and message are optional strings.

stage.description: Optional execution stage, merged into progress.stage.

message.description: Optional human-readable update, merged into progress.message.

execution_token.description: Optional private random capability for backend verification; never return it to a browser or log it.

p95_ms.description: Null until at least 20 valid samples are available.

failure_rate.description: Failed / (succeeded + failed) stopped attempts; cancellations excluded. Null without outcomes.

released_at.description: First confirmed stop or handoff; old released records without a recorded timestamp remain null.

progress.description: The saved progress snapshot; older events may have an empty object.
